QuestInfo.name: Sleepy Expression
QuestInfo.0: #p1052121# is convinced you should take an #bacting class#k. What kind of class might it be? Talk to #p1052121# standing in front of the Hair Salon in #bHenesys Market#k.
QuestInfo.1: You have decided to learn the sleepy expression. You can learn it from #b#p1092004##k from #m120000400##k in #bNautilus#k, since he's always falling in sleep. You should take care of the nearby monsters so he doesn't wake up.
QuestInfo.2: You have learned the sleepy expression.

0.0: How are your adventures going, #h0#? I still can't believe you'd choose a life on the road over the posh excess of celebrity...oh well. Shall we continue on to the next acting class?

yes.0: Today we begin our fifth lesson. The sleepy expression is difficult to master, but I have faith in you.
yes.1: Doesn't the word 'sleepy' remind you of someone? #b#p1092004##k in #m120000400##k of #bNautilus#k can't seem to stay awake, can he?
yes.2: You should help make #p1092004# more comfortable. Eliminating the #rPigs#k around Nautilus will help. Good luck.

no.0: These classes will only increase your Charm. You shouldn't give up after getting this far.

npc.0: Haven't you been to see #b#p1092004##k yet? He's always sleeping at in #m120000400##k at #bNautilus#k.

mob.0: Zzz...! Monsters! Monsters are...where? Ah, why do I keep dreaming about those dang #rPigs#k?
